fields.name: Equipment
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x34FF220 (size 0x28) copies the first member with bg3.exe+0x5ED3F0: an array of 4-byte elements with FixedString IncRef on each. The source is a 0x28-byte value of the map EquipmentSystem.EquipmentSet (HashMap<EntityHandle, EquipmentSetRequest>, loop at the end of bg3.exe+0x34F8730, stride 0x28): the component is a copy of Script Extender's esv::inventory::EquipmentSetRequest (Components/Inventory.h), created when bg3.exe+0x34F9960 could not apply the request this frame. Capture: heap pointer, capacity 1, size 1 on all 3 instances.

fields.name: RemoveOldEquipmentSets
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x34FF220 copies one byte from +0x10 of the EquipmentSetRequest (Script Extender names it RemoveOldEquipmentSets); bg3.exe+0x34F8730 passes it as the 5th argument of bg3.exe+0x34F9960. Capture: always 0.

fields.name: _Pad11
fields.evidence: padding before the 8-aligned Guid; the creator does not write it, capture shows garbage (34 80 01 / ff ff ff)

fields.name: ShapeshiftState
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x34FF220 copies 16 bytes +0x18..+0x28 as four dwords; bg3.exe+0x34F9960 receives the pointer to it (param_6), tests it for non-zero and copies it into esv::inventory::ShapeshiftAddedEquipmentComponent of every item it equips. Script Extender: EquipmentSetRequest.ShapeshiftState. Capture: all zero.

open_questions: The component could be declared as a single member of type esv::inventory::EquipmentSetRequest (same 40 bytes); the flat form is given so that the generator needs no external type.
